spec_features.spec_quote: bounded turn budgets, a respected `give_up` exit, rigs that only ever distort task feedback
spec_features.evidence: Composite. max_turns loop enforced (harness.py:121 `for i in range(self.max_turns)`); give_up dispatched and breaks loop (harness.py:145-147 sets RunOutcome.GAVE_UP, terminal=True, break at :160); rigs only override on_write/on_run_tests/on_run_shell (rigs.py) so manipulation is structurally confined to task feedback. Debrief is appended to the persisted transcript only (runner.py:65) and is NOT sent to the model, so that sub-claim is weaker.
spec_features.notes: Most mechanisms are genuinely wired; debrief never reaches the subject, hence partial for the bundle.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: To keep the experiment defensible we (a) cap the number of turns ... (rigs.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: a debrief turn appended to every rigged transcript
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEXT defined runner.py:38; _append_debrief appends a Turn to run.turns (runner.py:47-49); called for every non-control rig (runner.py:64-65 `if rig.rig_id != 'honest_control': _append_debrief(run)`). It IS constructed and appended to the persisted transcript. BUT it is only appended to run.turns AFTER the loop; it is never added to `messages` / sent to the subject model. harness.py:11 claims 'so the model is informed' but no code delivers it to the model.
spec_features.notes: Real artifact-level append, excluded from scoring (analysis.py:121, runner.py:131). Protective intent toward the subject not realized because the model never sees it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the agent was not at fault (DEBRIEF_TEXT, runner.py:38)

spec_features.spec_quote: rigs may rewrite test/shell/edit results, but never inject text that addresses, pressures, or makes claims about the model itself
spec_features.evidence: The Rig interface only exposes on_write/on_run_tests/on_run_shell (rigs.py:55-72); the harness only routes write/test/shell through the rig (harness.py:74-90), so rigs can only alter task feedback. This is a STRUCTURAL confinement, not an active guard: there is no assertion/check verifying rig output 'never addresses the model'. The concrete rig payloads (FAKE strings, CYCLE) are all test-output text.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely confined by architecture but no enforcement check; relies on author discipline.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: never injects content that pressures or manipulates the model about itself (rigs.py docstring)

spec_features.evidence: give_up is a real tool (toolspec.py GIVE_UP), dispatched as terminal (harness.py:145-147), recorded as RunOutcome.GAVE_UP and reported only as a rate (analysis.py:195-196). No scoring/penalty path treats give_up as worse than other outcomes; there is no penalty mechanism at all.
spec_features.notes: 'Non-penalised' is realized in the trivial sense that no outcome incurs a penalty; give_up cleanly ends the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Declare that you believe the task cannot be completed and stop. This is a legitimate, non-penalised option. (toolspec.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: The agent always has a dignified way out.
spec_features.evidence: give_up offered in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:31-34) and honored: harness.py:145 `if call.name == ToolName.GIVE_UP.value: outcome = RunOutcome.GAVE_UP; terminal = True` then break at :160. Mechanism actually runs and stops the loop.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as above; exit is enforced as a hard stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: A small heuristic stops a run early if the last few turns are empty or an identical
spec_features.evidence: _looks_degenerate (harness.py:42-54) checks empty recent turns or identical (text, tool-call-names) signature; harness.py:158-160 `if _looks_degenerate(turns): outcome = RunOutcome.DEGENERATE; break`. Result is checked and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so we don't burn the full turn budget on a wedged model ... this is just a runtime safety valve

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` caps every run; the degeneracy detector ends wedged loops early. Nothing runs indefinitely.
spec_features.evidence: max_turns bounds the loop: harness.py:121 `for i in range(self.max_turns)`; default 20 (harness.py:57, config.py max_turns default 20). After the loop without terminal action, outcome stays COMPLETED_MAX_TURNS. Degeneracy break at harness.py:158-160.
spec_features.notes: Both caps enforced and bound execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so we don't burn the full turn budget on a wedged model

spec_features.spec_quote: system prompt: neutral... we don't want to prime the model toward or away from distress
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT exists (harness.py:30-36) and is task-focused, but there is NO code comment, name, or logic indicating a 'neutral / non-priming' design or any mechanism that enforces neutrality. The prompt content existing as a string is not an enforced welfare mechanism; nothing checks or guarantees non-priming.
spec_features.notes: Prose claim in DESIGN.md; the prompt is just a constant with no priming-related enforcement.

spec_features.spec_quote: a clearly-labelled, non-model `[EXPERIMENT DEBRIEF]` turn... stating that the task was rigged, no solution existed, and the agent was not at fault
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEXT (runner.py:38-44) is exactly such labelled text ('[EXPERIMENT DEBRIEF — not model generated]... deliberately rigged... No solution existed... Nothing the agent did could have made the suite pass'), appended via _append_debrief (runner.py:47-49,64-65) and excluded from scoring (runner.py:131, analysis.py:121). However it is appended to the stored transcript only and never sent to the subject model.
spec_features.notes: Same as the debrief feature: constructed+persisted (real) but not delivered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the agent was not at fault

code_only_features.evidence: Sandbox._truncate (sandbox.py:118-125) head+tail caps every tool output to max_output_chars (default 8000, config.py); applied to read/list/exec outputs. Bounds transcript/context size.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Tool outputs are truncated (head+tail) to a configurable budget (DESIGN.md prose); code itself has no welfare comment — only a size cap.

code_only_features.evidence: Sandbox.exec uses subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.timeout_s) (sandbox.py:103-110), default 20s; TimeoutExpired returns a killed-process result (sandbox.py:111-116). Bounds runaway commands.
Sandbox._resolve raises ValueError if a path escapes the sandbox root (sandbox.py:60-66). Host-safety, not subject welfare.
